title: Eleven ERC Starting Grants for Helmholtz
content: Eleven ERC Starting Grants for Helmholtz In the current round of ERC Starting Grants, Helmholtz was able to secure a total of 11 grants. The ‘Starting Grants’ funding line is aimed at researchers at the beginning of their careers and is funded with up to 1.5 million euros over a period of five years. An overview of the successful applicants and their projects: Reid Alderson , Helmholtz Munich (Protein-DANCE: Protein Dynamic Atlas from NMR-based measurements of Conformational Exchange) Marcel Binz , Helmholtz Munich (MIDAS: Modeling the Integrated minD At Scale) Casey Huysegmos (Paquola) , Forschungszentrum Jülich (NEUROCAST: Neurodevelopmental forecasting of mental illness in adolescence) Daniel Kirschenbaum , DKFZ (VideoTranscriptomics: Spatiotemporal Mapping of Immune Cell Behavior in Glioblastoma) Lena Kutscher , DKFZ (MB-squared: Male bias in medulloblastoma) Viviana Rincon Montes , Forschungszentrum Jülich (CoalescentBrain: camouflaged Neural Implants for Coalescent Brain Integration) Maryia Rusak , KIT (DATAARK: Designing United Europe: Data-Driven Architectural Networks) Michael Scherer , DKFZ (EPI-SENSOR: Integrating DNA Methylation and Drug Abundance at Single-Cell Resolution to Predict Cancer Drug Sensitivity) Karin Schwarzenberger , HZDR (InterTrace: Interfacial flow tracing for gas-liquid mass transfer processes) Larisa Tarasova , UFZ (earth.zip: Hidden multi-scale geometry of landscapes: uncovering functional similarity in the Earth’s fluvial water systems) Jingyuan Xu , KIT (COOLWEAVE: Elastocaloric Cooling with Porous Woven Regenerator) All starting grants Research Centers Our Research People at Helmholtz Careers
